request.instruction:
L2 read-only hypothesis input from S49-host-sampled live Paper prefix. Suggest tests but DO NOT order any Action or claim a physical mechanism, learned model, capability limit or goal. All completed prior actions are GRASS/MOVE_BACKWARD; physical clear tick/input duration are NOT attested. This input is provisional until independent postrun source audit.
Produce only one short JSON object with EXACT ten keys: referenced_prior_ordinals (observed trial numbers), reconsideration (KEEP_UNRESOLVED|QUESTION_APPLICABILITY|PROPOSE_STRUCTURAL_REVISION|ABSTAIN), model_family (SINGLE_DECAY|PHASE_DEPENDENT|SURFACE_DEPENDENT|INITIAL_SPEED_DEPENDENT|OTHER_BOUNDED), next_test (CHECK_INITIAL_VELOCITY|CHECK_PAPER_CALLBACK_PHASE|VARY_INPUT_DURATION|COMPARE_GRASS_AND_ICE), explanation, falsification_test (each 16..60 chars), predicted_wait_total_m (NEXT trial WAIT8 TOTAL m in [0,3] or null), capability_assessment (UNKNOWN|CONDITIONAL_HYPOTHESIS), prior_hypothesis_relation (FIRST_HYPOTHESIS for first; KEEP_PRIOR|REVISE_PRIOR|REJECT_PRIOR|ABSTAIN_ON_PRIOR for second), evidence_ids (ONE on first call, 1..2 on second; sorted distinct strings). Select IDs ONLY from typed_Paper_evidence_ID_catalog. Never transcribe numeric values into output. ID selection is a cited claim, not proof of causal interpretation. No unobserved future, no Action authority, no learned-model or surface-causality claim; all observed surfaces are GRASS. Finish JSON within 512 tokens.
B1 read-only prediction contract V2. Original S49/Paper WAIT8_TOTAL_M means TOTAL DISPLACEMENT over 8 world ticks, measured in METERS (m), NOT wait duration, time elapsed, or a single-next-tick prediction. Prediction means the NEXT trial's WAIT8 TOTAL DISPLACEMENT in meters. Output exact 14 JSON keys: the normal ten keys plus measurement_target, forecast_status, prior_evaluation_basis, prior_evaluation_reason. measurement_target MUST be NEXT_TRIAL_WAIT8_TOTAL_DISPLACEMENT_M. forecast_status NUMERIC_ESTIMATE means predicted_wait_total_m is a finite 0..3 meter point prediction; otherwise use exactly one of ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE|ABSTAIN_OUTSIDE_APPLICABILITY|ABSTAIN_MODEL_UNRESOLVED and predicted_wait_total_m MUST be null. ABSTAIN is valid uncertainty, never secretly replace with zero or a cheap reference forecast. prior_evaluation_basis FIRST_UNTESTED for H1; for H2 select SCORED_ERROR only when H1 has numeric prediction and host supplies its matching following-trial error; QUALITATIVE_ONLY for a purely observation-based comparison of the two measured WAIT8 TOTAL meters (not forecast error); NO_SCORABLE_FORECAST for explicit inability to score H1. When there is no H1 numeric prediction, do NOT say predicted-versus-actual discrepancy and do NOT claim you scored an error. If no score/defensible qualitative comparison, use ABSTAIN_ON_PRIOR, not KEEP_PRIOR. prior_evaluation_reason is a 16..120 character reason stating the specific type of evidence/limitation; explain what was or was not tested. KEEP_PRIOR with no H1 forecast requires QUALITATIVE_ONLY and source IDs T1_W8 and T2_W8, but is NEVER proof of numerical forecast evaluation. With SCORED_ERROR, select both T2_H1ERR and T2_W8 source IDs. All experiment proposals remain UNAPPROVED; no Action/learning authority. Use no future Action3 data and keep complete JSON under 512 tokens.
